headline: Molten Core in 36:23 after Blackwing Lair, two boss deaths

mvp.headline: the most damage on five bosses, second on four more
why: First on Lucifron, Gehennas, Sulfuron, Golemagg and Majordomo, second on Garr, Geddon, Shazzrah and Ragnaros
Kicked a Dark Mending on Sulfuron

also.text: 121 dispels, the most: 31 Immolates, 18 Cauterizing Flames, 6 Impending Dooms
main tank on nine bosses, parse 97 on Geddon and 96 on Ragnaros through 62 Elemental Fires
the most damage on Magmadar, Garr and Ragnaros

overview: Ten kills on ten pulls in 36:23, against a usual 44:48, the same evening as Blackwing Lair. Two boss deaths: Malyric to Shazzrah's Arcane Explosion at 0:25 and Roguina to a Flamewaker Healer's Shadow Bolt on Majordomo at 0:36.
A Firelord's Massive Tremor killed Selenax and Mercîless on trash, and Selenax and Marulock aren't in the log after Magmadar.
Shazzrah was the one slow boss: 0:29 against a usual 0:21, parse median 61 against 78.

wentWell.text: 4 of Sulfuron's 6 Dark Mendings kicked (Gertggs, Nessla, Sneakycatto, Tochopolvo).
Lucifron in 0:26 with 18 curses and 17 Impending Dooms removed.
Ragnaros in 0:53 (median 1:08), no deaths, Tochopolvo parse 97.
